item.title: Henrietta Lacks died at 31, but her cells lived on and transformed modern medicine
item.description: Henrietta Lacks' cervical cancer cells became immortal, revolutionizing biomedical research and medical advancements. The story highlights critical ethical debates concerning patient consent and financial benefits. This legacy continues to shape discussions on scientific progress and human dignity.
